properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL — ideas from the `proj:bhome` feedback report, 2026-08-31, relayed by Anthony for review. Nothing chosen. The ideas are the reporter's; the convergence noted below is this session's reading of them.

═══ WHAT WAS MEASURED THERE ═══
Genesis of a new design: 13 requirements + 9 capabilities took 22 calls; wiring them took 44 edges, of which **22 were pure `CONTAINS proj:bhome -> child` boilerplate that could not have been anything else.** Its own words: "the containment is never in doubt at creation time."

═══ THE IDEAS AS FILED ═══
① `add_requirement` / `add_capability` take `project_id` inline — removes 22 of 44 edge writes with no loss of meaning.
② `add_capability` takes `satisfies: [req_id, ...]` inline — kills a round trip.
③ A genesis bulk-seed call — N requirements, M capabilities and the satisfies matrix in one atomic write, so seeding a brief is not "60+ writes that can half-land". `import_graph` exists but is aimed at adoption.
④ `quality_target` as a parameter on `add_decision` — an accepted decision with a quality target currently takes three calls, and unlike the `proposed` default there is no argument for the separation.

⭐⭐ THE CONVERGENCE, WHICH IS WORTH MORE THAN THE ROUND TRIPS: ② IS A THIRD REPAIR FOR A KNOWN DEFECT. `fact:the-near-match-filter-has-no-node-type-term` records two candidate repairs for the cross-type duplicate refusal — ① exclude the prescribed layer pairs (removes a real catch), ② reword the refusal (keeps every catch, costs a round trip). The conservative one shipped.

The reporter's idea supplies a THIRD that neither weakens the guard nor merely rewords it: **if the capability declares in the same call that it SATISFIES the requirement it resembles, the "is this a duplicate?" question is already answered before the guard runs.** The guard keeps its full strength against genuine same-type duplication, and the canonical genesis pattern stops tripping it because the caller has supplied the discriminating fact.

⇒ That is a better shape than either recorded option, and it arrived from a user hitting the friction rather than from anyone reasoning about the guard.

═══ ⭐ THERE IS IN-TREE PRECEDENT, SO THIS IS NOT A NEW PATTERN ═══
· `add_change_event` already takes `affected: [...]` and draws a CHANGED edge per entry in the same call — and refuses the WHOLE call before writing anything if an entry names a node that does not exist.
· `link_artifact` already creates an Artifact, a provenance Fragment and a REALIZES edge atomically.
Both are creation calls that carry their own links. ①–③ are the same move applied to the two most-used capture tools.

═══ ⚠️ COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, recorded beside rather than used to argue the ideas down ═══
(1) EVERY OPTIONAL PARAMETER IS SURFACE, and the served tool descriptions are already against a 1500-character budget that this project hit and had to trim on 2026-08-31. Four new parameters is not free.
(2) THE SEPARATION MAY BE LOAD-BEARING SOMEWHERE. `add_decision`'s `proposed` default is defended explicitly — asserting acceptance on the user's behalf would forge their word. The reporter grants that and argues `quality_target` has no equivalent defence, which looks right but has not been checked against whatever reasoning originally separated them.
(3) A BULK-SEED CALL IS A SECOND CAPTURE PATH, and reflow2 already has one — `import_graph` — whose existence did not stop 60 individual writes happening. A third path that is also not reached for would be worse than none.
(4) INLINE LINKS MOVE FAILURES EARLIER BUT MAKE THEM COARSER: `add_change_event`'s all-or-nothing semantics are right for edges, and would mean a typo in one `satisfies` id refuses the capability itself.
properties.name: OPEN — should add_requirement / add_capability take project_id and satisfies INLINE? bhome measured 22 of 44 edge writes as pure boilerplate, and it would dissolve the cross-type duplicate refusal rather than tune it
